sloka: प्रायेण हि निमित्तानामीदृशानां समुद्भवे ।राजा हि मृत्युमाप्नोति घोरं वापदमृच्छति ॥२-४-१९॥
transliteration: prāyeṇa hi nimittānāmīdṛśānāṁ samudbhave ।rājā hi mṛtyumāpnoti ghoraṁ vāpadamṛcchati ॥2-4-19॥

translations.english: When such ominous signs appear, usually the king either meets with death or faces a grave calamity.
